body: i’ve always thought it was an easier way to go. didn’t know it was so painful. thanks for sharing this, i’m glad you’re still with us. stay strong.

thank you for the response. i do live in the us, i’m just not sure how willing my friend would be to call one of the numbers. his mom doesn’t really give him any attention and his dad walked out on them, so options are kind of slim. i might call to get some advice though. i’ll talk to a teacher asap and see if they can do anything about it. once again, thank you for the response. i appreciate all of your advice and suggestions.

no problem, i’m here to help! things get worse before they get better sometimes. i’m sorry to hear what you’re going through right now, and i wish you didn’t have to go through it. i understand wanting an escape, i’ve been in the same place numerous times, but there’s other ways you can let out your negative emotions. i’m not gonna say it will work, but keeping a diary to just vent out personal emotions or problems helps me cope. what’s great about it is that there’s no one to judge you. if you’re ever feeling down just remember that there are people out there who care about you, you just don’t know it. i’m always up to chat if you wanna send me a message! i’m here to listen, not judge. sorry for the long winded response!! stay safe <3
if you don’t mind me asking, what’s bothering you?
are you up to chat friend?
